description: Turns two voltages into whole numbers, does bit operations on them and puts the answers back out as voltages

inputs.text: The first number, N, taken from 0-10V as a whole number of 23 bits
The second number, M, taken the same way, and also used as the shift distance for the two shift outputs

outputs.text: Every bit that is set in N or in M
Every bit that is set in both N and M
Every bit that is set in one of N and M but not the other
N with its bits moved down by as many places as M sets, 0 to 22
N with its bits moved up by as many places as M sets, 0 to 22, with anything above 23 bits dropped
N with every one of its 23 bits turned the other way
M with every one of its 23 bits turned the other way

notes: bit operations on a smooth signal give hard-edged steps, which is what makes the module a sound source rather than a calculator

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
